issuing_body: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) (厚生労働省大臣官房厚生科学課・医政局研究開発政策課)
covered_actors: Academic research institutions (学術研究機関)
Private enterprises conducting joint R&D with medical institutions (民間企業等)
Prefectural and municipal health authorities, national R&D agencies, independent administrative agencies, and relevant medical associations (addressed for dissemination)

evidence.quote: つきましては、貴管下関係施設において、別添をご参照いただくとともに、貴管下関係者への周知方お願い申し上げます。
evidence.quote_en: Accordingly, we request that relevant facilities under your jurisdiction refer to the attached document and that you disseminate it to relevant stakeholders under your jurisdiction.

implementation_notes: One-page MHLW administrative transmittal notice (事務連絡) dated September 30, 2024 (Reiwa 6), formally circulating the MHLW-funded ELSI research group's 'Guidelines on the Utilization of Medical Digital Data for AI Research and Development' (jp_medical_digital_data_ai_guideline_2024) to prefectures, municipalities, national research institutions, and relevant medical organizations. The notice summarizes the attached guideline's purpose—clarifying appropriate legal bases across R&D stages and procedures/operations for creating pseudonymized medical information in joint medical-institution, academic, and private-sector product development—without establishing standalone operative obligations or enforcement mechanisms of its own.
